messages:
Karim Omar: hi everyone  Karim here (he/him), first day on Eng-Platform. remote PST. quick list: 1) MDM invite not showing up yet  who should I ping? 2) need VPN/staging access and read-only to the perf logs bucket. 3) where are the first-week small tasks/repos to open a tiny PR? also fun fact: training for an ultramarathon and addicted to trail mix. :running_shirt_with_sash: :trail_of_bread:

Nina (Buddy): welcome Karim!! :tada: Im Nina, your buddy for the first month. Ill DM to sync 30m today. For first tasks, start with the onboarding checklist in the eng-platform repo (small README fix + a test that runs locally). Ill drop the link in DM.

Raj (IT): hey Karim  MDM invites usually go out automatically but can be flaky. If you dont see it: visit https://intranet.redwood/mdm-enroll and re-open the Company Portal. Ill resend the invite now. For VPN, request role `staging-vpn` in the access portal and include your manager and intended test window. For bucket read-only, request role `perf-logs-read` and paste the ticket ID here. To add your SSH key: `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub | pbcopy` and paste into your profile page.

Karim Omar: thanks Raj  resend looks like it showed up at 09:07. submitting the access request for `staging-vpn` and `perf-logs-read` now.

Ivy (People Ops): welcome Karim :balloon: welcome kit & sticker pack shipped. default laptop is MacBook Pro 14"  if you prefer a 14" Linux, reply here and well swap. Orientation invite sent. Also FYI we do a casual onboarding coffee with the Platform team on Fridays.

Sam H.: hey Karim  once youre in #eng-platform Ill add you to the perf-monitoring dashboard and the weekly infra sync. If you want early access to the dedicated GPU pool for local perf runs, tell me your team + use-case and Ill approve a short window.

DevexBot: Reminder: join #eng-platform and #devex to see pairing slots and repo readmes. New-repo checklist: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/ONBOARDING.md

Nina (Buddy): sending the 30-min intro invite for 11:00 PST. Ill include a 3-item first-week todo list so you can open a tiny PR on day 2. Also trail-mix tips are welcome. :grin:

Karim Omar: awesome  accepted invites, access request filed (ticket #PL-9901) and pasted SSH key. thanks everyone  happy to jump into the README fix tomorrow and to bring trail-mix to Friday coffee. :seedling:
